set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWY8W7DP7TBKH918WVRG20YW. Problem: FuturePipelineRunner needs production-grade semantic tests before domain pipelines rely on it. Harden bounded concurrency behavior, deterministic receipt ordering, thrown exception attribution, missing-input handling, repeated runs with different contexts, and parity with LocalPipelineRunner. Acceptance: JVM/JS tests demonstrate stable results across bounded/unbounded policies; warnings remain clean; no scheduler dependency enters the generic core.
set.title: Pipeline: harden execution policy semantics
